text: Yes, native forest was deforested on this property in 2022. The analysis detected a 0.6-hectare loss of tree cover, of which 0.5 hectares was confirmed as native forest by Uruguay’s official forest map (MGAP 2021). The loss met the criteria for deforestation: it was observed in 2022, the area was mapped as forest in 2020 (JRC GFC2020), and the event exceeded the 0.5-hectare minimum threshold. While 0.2 hectares of loss occurred in small patches (under 0.5 ha each), this did not affect the overall classification. The total native forest loss represents 3.4% of the property’s area.
